# Hardest-to-round inputs for exp() over the C fixed-point _Accum formats.
#
# Generated by scripts/fxp_exp_worstcase.c, which sweeps every input in the
# band where exp() is neither 0 nor saturated, in exact arithmetic. Each row
# is an EXHAUSTIVE result for that exact (width, frac_bits, signedness)
# triple -- it says nothing about any other format, not even one with the
# same storage width, because both the sample spacing (frac bits) and the
# range cutoff (integer bits) change the function being sampled.
#
# "interm" is the number of fractional bits an intermediate needs for the
# final rounding to be decidable for every input: frac_bits + ceil(distance
# in bits) + 2 of margin.
#
# Reproduce with, e.g.:
#   fxp-exp-worstcase 64 32 u 32
#
# width  frac  sign  worst_raw       distance        bits      interm
16       7     s     -710            8.4805774401e-04  10.2035  19
16       8     u     1259            7.7580974840e-05  13.6539  23
32       15    s     -157921         5.3500430106e-07  20.8339  37
32       16    u     454390          9.9586705236e-07  19.9375  37
64       31    s     -24653613033    1.5512717104e-11  35.9078  68
64       32    u     4292887832      3.3253084681e-13  41.4516  75
